resources.string: Internet, web addresses and open ports
Every minute your DeKoi checks that your router answers, that the internet can be reached and that web addresses can be looked up.
Your DeKoi reports its first measurements an hour after it starts.
Your DeKoi found no time without internet.

resources.string: Web addresses lead where they should.
Some web addresses lead to the wrong place.
Your DeKoi could not check this the last time it tried.
Once an hour your DeKoi looks up a few well-known addresses through your router and through an independent service, and compares the answers.
Devices can ask your router to open a port, so that others on the internet can reach them. Your DeKoi reads the list once an hour and never changes it.

resources.string: No device has asked your router to open a port.
Your router does not share which ports are open. Most routers share this only while devices may open ports by themselves, a setting that is safer off.
Websites and services see this address when anyone in your home uses them.
Your DeKoi reports this with its next hourly check.
DeKoi sees only its own traffic, so it cannot show how much each device uses. A mode that can is planned.
Once a night your DeKoi downloads 25 MB from Cloudflare and measures how fast it arrives. It counts towards your data allowance, if you have one.
Turn it on to see how fast your connection is.
The first result arrives after the next night.
